title: fix(fields): lookup multi-value hydration batches via $in and shows loading instead of the empty placeholder (#3108)
body:
Closes #3108.

## Problem

A multi-value lookup hydrated its committed ids with a **serial `findOne` per id** — 41 selected users meant 41 sequential HTTP round-trips. For those seconds the trigger rendered the bare "Select…" placeholder, indistinguishable from having no value at all: downstream users (os-project-titanwind-ehr#670) read a populated field as empty, and could clear real data by hand.

## Fix (`packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`)

- **Batched hydration**: several unresolved ids now resolve with one `$filter: { [idField]: { $in: chunk } }` query per `LOOKUP_PAGE_SIZE` chunk, chunks in parallel. The single-id case keeps the pre-existing cheap paths (primary-id `findOne` GET, equality filter for a non-primary `id_field` — #3508 behaviour preserved).
- **Hydration loading state**: while any committed bare id is still unresolved, the trigger — and the readonly renderer — shows a spinner + "N selected" (raw committed count) instead of the empty placeholder. Reuses existing i18n keys (`table.selected` / `lookup.loading`); no new translations.
- **No stuck spinner**: a settled-set marks attempted ids (found or not), so deleted records / fetch failures fall back to the pre-existing drop behaviour instead of spinning forever.

On issue point 3 (guarding against submit clearing values): the component never rewrites `value` from resolved options — `handleSelect`/`handleRemove` operate on the raw committed array — so mid-hydration submits were already lossless; the loading state removes the visual lie that invited manual clearing.

## Verification

- **Unit**: new `LookupField.hydration.test.tsx` (5 cases: one batched `$in` round-trip, in-flight count+spinner with no placeholder, failure settles, readonly loading, single-id `findOne` kept) + existing idField/dependsOn suites — 13/13 green.
- **Live UI** (framework app-showcase backend + HMR console, real browser): a `field_zoo.f_lookups` record with 41 selected accounts hydrates via a single `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?top=41&filter=["id","in",[…41 ids…]]`; with simulated slow network the edit modal shows spinner + "已选择 41 项" during hydration (never "选择…"), all 41 chips render after, and the stored value stays 41 ids across repeated open/close.

Pure bug fix — no changeset per AGENTS.md.
